config._comment: LiSenNet (arXiv:2409.13285, hyyan2k/LiSenNet, MIT) ported into this framework. Hyperparameters follow the upstream config.yaml: VoiceBank-DEMAND, n_fft=512/hop=256, 2 s segments, AdamW lr 5e-4 betas [0.8,0.99], StepLR gamma 0.98/epoch, CMGAN losses (complex 0.1, mag 0.9, adv 0.05). num_channels=16, n_blocks=2 -> ~37k-param generator. Phase via Griffin-Lim (no phase loss). batch_size is 16 (not the paper's 4): the model is tiny (0.77 GB at batch 16) but each step pays a fixed CPU-PESQ + Griffin-Lim cost, so batch 4 is needlessly slow (~32 min/epoch vs ~4.3 at batch 16); per-sample norms make MetricGAN batch-robust.

candidate.reason: Published recipe uses the benchmark test split for validation and checkpoint selection. Actual checkpoint-specific selection logs are absent, so a held-out claim cannot be established.

next_steps: Retain the verified official LiSenNet architecture and waveform adapter.
Audit author-provided or independently selected weights if available.
Implement training/validation selection from the train split in Phase 3.
Proceed with TF-GridNet architecture integration using the existing shared waveform and metric interfaces.
